native_algorithms.lutq: Nearest-code forward, latent STE update, one Lloyd center update per minibatch; task-independent source models
native_algorithms.yeh: Categorical A*phi, signed/fixed-zero adaptation; true implicit support/query gradient with Neumann20; 250 initial and20 subsequent inner Adam updates
native_algorithms.msr: Continuous U*phi; full higher-order MAML, inner1/train3/checkpoint; learned initialization and unconstrained per-group SGD rates

minibatch: Up to32 source tasks and up to512 support examples; source H0 only for outer loss/checkpoints
transferred: Structure only in primary comparison, no post-clustering of any competitor; native MSR initialization saved for separate auxiliary evaluation
published_comparison: Adapted same FC architecture and data/loss as ours; not literal published CNN/init-transfer results
